_comment: Upstream hashes at the moment each shadow was last reviewed. Regenerate with `pnpm shadows:record` ONLY after reading the upstream diff. `why` says what the fork is for; `declined` lists upstream commits deliberately not ported, so the next reviewer does not re-derive it. See scripts/shadow-drift.mjs.

@plone/volto-slate/blocks/Text/DefaultTe.why: Owns the slate sidebar UX: adds a sidebar 'Body' field reading blocksConfig.slate.schema so the slate body is editable from the side panel, with the shortcut listing and markdown help below it. Deliberately drops upstream's inline <SlateEditor>, slash menu, image dropzone and BlockChooserButton — slate editing happens in the iframe, and the admin only mounts this inside a display:none div, so all of that would be invisible work.

declined.c1ee09f78: img -> Image component: in the inline editor render we deleted.
declined.afcb3cfaa: intl passed to initialValue: part of the inline editor path we do not run.
declined.dd35efb7a: barrel imports: the imports it rewrote are ones this fork does not have.

@plone/volto-slate/blocks/Text/MarkdownI.why: Makes the sidebar markdown help collapsible (collapsed by default) to cut sidebar clutter. Content is otherwise upstream's.

@plone/volto-slate/editor/plugins/Markdo.why: Fixes cursor placement after an autoformat wrap: upstream leaves the cursor INSIDE the new inline, so the trigger space lands inside <strong>/<em> instead of after it. Moves to the point after the inline, inserting an empty text node when the inline is the last child. Pure addition — upstream's logic above it is unchanged.

volto/components/manage/Form/BlocksToolb.why: Upstream assumes every block lives at formData.blocks / blocks_layout, i.e. page level. This fork fires `hydra-paste-blocks` / `hydra-delete-blocks` document events instead, which View.jsx handles with the container-aware helpers it already owns, rather than rebuilding blockPathMap here.

declined.dd35efb7a: rewrites Blocks/uuid imports this fork dropped when it moved the work into View.jsx.

volto/components/manage/Sidebar/SidebarP.why: Replaces semantic-ui's doesNodeContainClick with a bounding-rect hit test, and ignores untrusted events. doesNodeContainClick walks the parentNode chain, which fails when a React re-render detaches nodes between mousedown and the check — the popup then concluded the click was outside and closed the object browser unexpectedly.

declined.dd35efb7a: re-adds the doesNodeContainClick import — the very thing this fork removes on purpose.

volto/components/manage/Sidebar/SidebarP.why: Returns null unless SidebarPortalTargetContext is set. Hydra drives all sidebar rendering through ParentBlocksWidget with an explicit target; upstream always portals into `tab` (default sidebar-properties), which would render block sidebars twice. Upstream is SidebarPortal.tsx now; this stays .jsx because the logic differs anyway and shadowing resolves by specifier, not extension.

declined.e894c0654: TypeScript refactor. Not adoptable wholesale: our render is conditional on the context and differs structurally. Nothing functional in it to port.

volto/components/manage/Widgets/ImageWid.why: Exposes the widget for INLINE use from the slate toolbar's image popup, which upstream cannot do: showPreview={false} drops the preview/Message wrapper (SyncedSlateToolbar renders <ImageInput showPreview={false}>), onClose lets the popup dismiss itself, the accepted file types come from the FIELD's schema rather than a hard-coded image/*, and the picker is AddLinkForm so it matches the toolbar's link popup. Upload logic is shared between the sidebar and inline paths. Drag-and-drop is NOT a reason to fork: upstream 19.1.1 has its own <Dropzone>, so those calls are parity. The inline dropzone root carries data-testid="image-picker-inline" — Volto's convention for an element that exists only for tests to find. It was a bare unstyled class, which read as styling and got deleted as dead CSS once already.

volto/components/theme/View/View.jsx.why: Hydra renders the page in the preview iframe, so the admin must NOT render RenderedView at all; this fork replaces it with <Iframe>, mounted as the FIRST child so it keeps its position in the React tree whether content is null (loading) or loaded, and so is never remounted. A slot can add to the view, not remove its content render, so this cannot become a slot registration. Also redirects to /login without a token, where upstream renders <span/>.

declined.29a1bbb6e: key={flattenToAppURL(content['@id'])} on RenderedView — we never render RenderedView, so there is nothing to key.
declined.6a8f3bdec: AlternateHrefLangs — public-site SEO markup. The admin is not the public site; www is served by Nuxt/SSG, which emits its own hreflang.
